title: Unit 1 Consolidation: Nuance, Focus & Emphasis in Narrative

sections.title: Consolidation Goals
items: I can recognize and interpret pre-verbal focus and preverb-verb inversion across B2 literary passages.
I can recall B2 psychological and narrative vocabulary from Kosztolányi's 'Pacsirta'.
I can produce contrastive and exclusivity-focused sentences with accurate Hungarian word order.
